captions: Your watch buzzes. Step goal almost reached.
The market. You count prices, not blessings.
The old spice seller hands you your change.
His lips keep moving. Beads slide through his fingers.
He smiles: “Remember Allah, son. It's free.”
On the tram home, your earbuds stay in your pocket.
Your thumb on each finger. SubhanAllah. Again.
33. Your heart is quieter than it has been in weeks.

post.caption:
4,812 steps this morning. Not one SubhanAllah. 🤍

The old man at the market was right: remembering Allah is free, and it costs you nothing but a moment.

“So remember Me; I will remember you.” (2:152)

33 SubhanAllah on your way home. This morning.
